scope: All 387 fixed-lock npm dependency archives verified, including build-only and platform-specific optional packages as a conservative notice set. This is not a claim all are shipped or included into every JS file. No node_modules directory was present in the fixed base.
method: Official npm archives named by exact fixed lock; SHA-512 integrity verified before extracting package metadata and complete license/notice texts. No installation, build or package lifecycle scripts executed. Lock dependencies are an upper bound, not a claim all are embedded into each generated JS.
standalone_text_omissions: Some exact packages omitted standalone license files but explicitly declared their license in metadata. These have supplemental same-project upstream notices, with version/current-text limitations recorded per package. Build-only is-reference uses its exact MIT declaration and author field plus the standard MIT text, without inventing an upstream notice.
